name: Right On Brands, Inc.
summary: Right On Brands, Inc., a health and wellness company, manufactures, sells, markets, and retails a line of hemp enhanced snack foods. It offers Humbly Hemp snack bars; Humbly Hemp Sparkling Tea, ENDO Water, a wellness drink; ENDO Drops, a daily cannabidiol supplementation; ENDO Ease, a topical pain relief product; and ENDO Tokes, a pre-rolled CBD flower that comes in the shape of a cigarette. The company was formerly known as HealthTalk Live, Inc. and changed its name to Right On Brands, Inc. in August 2017. Right On Brands, Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Dallas, Texas.
